bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 7, 9. STITZER performed below market place expectations first up at Kembla Grange but he's trialed since and he will be competing today in blinkers for the first time. He can make a mockery of his latest effort when he now returns to his home course. GENTLE GIANT was responsible for an honest frontrunning debut effort last start at Kembla Grange. He can make natural improvement today when he presents at his home base. ROYAL PRINCESS kept trying at class one level on her Scone track last start and stepping back from 2200m when she now presents in weaker grade. ROULADEN must be forgiven for a Moruya defeat last start. There were excuses on the day!

raceTips.comment: Royal Princess has shown enough in recent outings to suggest she is capable of featuring prominently here. She has tactical speed and should be able to settle in a comfortable position without doing too much work early. Stilzer has been racing consistently and brings a solid level of form into this contest. He looks suited by the likely tempo and should be strong late if he gets clear running. Rouladen is lightly raced and still has scope to improve with more racing experience. He possesses enough speed to settle handy and can give a good kick when balanced up. Gentle Giant has been competitive without finding the right finish recently. He maps for a soft run and has the ability to be around the placings.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 4. UNHINGED must be forgiven for an unplaced first up effort when he struck traffic problems at Canterbury. He can make a mockery of his first up effort when he returns to the Kensington track second up this afternoon. CAVIAR concedes weight to all but he can be expected to rise to the occasion when he presents third up and at home base for the first time. WONKA has handed in pleasing efforts in defeat first and second up at Kembla Grange and then at Warwick Farm. He's now more than ready to make a Kensington track debut. BECHERS should not be harshly judged for a debut defeat at Newcastle when she became most unsuited in transit on the day. TRUE TONE refused to shirk his task in defeat after he conceded too great a task on debut at Kembla Grange. Stepping up from 1200m can already be regarded as a plus.

raceTips.comment: Wonka looks well placed on the strength of his recent performances and should appreciate having a genuine tempo to work into. He has good natural speed and can settle close enough to the leaders before producing his effort. Unhinged has continued to race honestly and has the profile of a horse that can give this a strong showing. He should be able to find a favourable position and conserve energy for the straight. Bechers has been building a consistent body of form and looks capable of holding his ground strongly late. He has enough early pace to avoid being too far away. True Tone is another who can make his presence felt with the right run. His finishing effort will be important.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 6, 7. LOW KEY must be forgiven for an unplaced debut effort here on the course proper after post-race issues were detected in a race that's produced excellent form. She was immediately spelled and she resumes today after trialing twice. She can return to the races muck improved. THREADS became unsuited in transit third up at Wyong when his effort was better than it appears on paper in a race won by the leader. FIABA presents on debut after trialing twice since a spell with James McDonald aboard on both occasions. She is now more than ready to make her debut. MOVIE STAR has beaten at Wyong at both outings in this her first campaign. She will however be more suitably placed on this more spacious track today.

raceTips.comment: The lightly raced Low Key is perfectly placed resuming this preparation over the 1100m, the filly has trialled strongly leading in and has the superior early speed in the race to find the front to dictate the tempo. Threads brings the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will figure in the finish over the suitable 1150m.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9. COLUMBUS can be given the chance to atone for his defeat last start at Warwick Farm when he was competing in blinkers for the first time. He should appreciate this spacious circuit at his first attempt. PIERRO LAD and Keagan Latham notched a hat-trick together when 1550m was the distance last start at Canterbury. Whilst this journey now becomes unchartered water, 1800m can now be okay. SUPREME SOVEREIGN struck trouble within this distance range at Canterbury when his effort was honest. MAZIS was resuming from a long spell at Warwick Farm with gear changes made. He was produced over 1400m on the day and he did suggest that this significant distance rise will already suit. MY CHARM was dominant when she tackled this trip second up at Hawkesbury and she should have more to offer when she now makes a Kensington track debut.

raceTips.comment: Columbus has the form credentials to make his presence felt and looks suited by the way this race is likely to be run. He can settle within striking distance and has shown he possesses a good turn of foot when produced at the right time. Mazis is racing with plenty of consistency and continues to give a good account of himself. He should settle economically and be able to build momentum through the latter stages. Supreme Sovereign has been competitive against solid opposition and brings the right racing pattern into this event. He can roll forward and make his own luck. Pierro Lad has shown enough ability to keep improving with racing. He looks capable of staying in touch and finishing off strongly.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 7, 10. DEEP PLEASURE was competing in blinkers for the first time when she was dominant at Warwick Farm within this distance range. She can be expected to maintain her form today. KOOLIBAH begins only his second campaign today. He will do so after trialing twice and unlike some, he can cope over this testing journey first up. PIERATA'S GEM struck traffic problems before she was beaten at Canterbury over this distance last start. She can atone for her costly defeat without causing a surprise today. AURA resumes after trialing at her Rosehill home base late last month. She was a first up Kembla Grange winner last campaign and she's anything but out of place first up again today. ZAMBORGHINI overcame problems to score within this distance range at Newcastle with Zac Wadick aboard and he should be treated with respect with Zac retaining the ride today.

raceTips.comment: The Price & Kent trained Deep Pleasure was a dominant all the way winner over 1600m last start and would have taken further improvement off that run, has the superior early speed to find the front and dictate the tempo to suit. Pieratas Gem continues to race well this preparation and is now at peak fitness, maps to enjoy the run of the race stalking the leading pair saved for one sprint at them late. Expecting competitive first up performances from Koolibah & Aura over the suitable 1550m with in form jockeys on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 8, 11. REGAL PROBLEM had trialed twice at her Warwick Farm home base before she handed in quick closing sectionals to score within this distance range first up at Gosford. She should already have more to offer this afternoon. SPHERE endured a tough run first up in the same Canterbury race which was last contested by CAFE AU LAIT. She refused to shirk her task in defeat and she now has scope to improve. cafe au lait presents second up. Her effort over this distance last start at Canterbury was more than good enough to be deserving of respect when she presents today, race-fitter. VARUNI presents third up and in search of a hat-trick. She's a Scone based very lightly raced mare who is now more than ready to make a metropolitan debut.

raceTips.comment: Regal Problem appeals as a strong contender after producing a series of solid efforts. He has the tactical speed to settle close to the action and should have every chance to get into the clear at the right stage. Cafe Au Lait has been finding the line well and looks suited by a race where there should be enough speed to bring him into contention. He can settle just off the leaders and conserve his energy. Sphere has displayed plenty of ability and remains capable of improving his overall profile. He should be able to settle comfortably and produce a sustained effort in the straight.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 6, 8, 10. KOMODO DRAGON had trialed twice before his first up effort in defeat at Canterbury was even better than it appears at face value. He returns to his home base suitably placed second up today. RIVENDEL hasn't been disgraced at either Canterbury outing since his spell and he now has scope to improve when he returns to his home track today. TOUGH GUY makes a Kensington track debut today after scoring with authority at home (Tamworth) last start. He is proven away from home! SIRAGUSA is resuming after trialing twice last month with Tom Sherry aboard on both occasions. He was dominant first up last campaign within this distance range at Muswellbrook with Tom aboard and this race is within reach with Tom retaining the ride today.

raceTips.comment: Tough Guy has been holding his form well and looks suited by the expected race shape. He has enough speed to settle prominently and should be able to dictate his own section of the race without spending too much energy early. Komodo Dragon has enough ability to make his presence felt and can improve with a more favourable run. He possesses a useful turn of foot when balanced up. Rivendell has been racing honestly and deserves respect on his overall form. He should be able to settle midfield and work home solidly over the concluding stages.
